name: IPI Partners
investor_type: infrastructure-focused investment platform (aka IPI Data Center Partners)
aum: ~$5.25B in equity commitments across its funds prior to its business being acquired by Blue Owl Capital in Jan 2025
notable_deals: Founded STACK Infrastructure at its Jan 15, 2019 launch (a joint venture of ICONIQ Capital and Iron Point Partners formed in 2016), combining Infomart and T5 data-center assets into a national platform. Remained STACK's majority owner/sponsor from 2019 until Blue Owl Capital acquired IPI Partners' entire asset-management business (~$1.0B) in a deal announced Oct 2024 and closed Jan 6, 2025.
notes: Added 2026-09-05 alongside the Blue Owl Capital <-> STACK Infrastructure correction Siddhi flagged. Kept as a separate historical record (STACK's 2019-2024 founding sponsor) rather than merged into Blue Owl, since it has independent historical relevance and ICONIQ Capital appears to retain some ongoing affiliate-level role post-acquisition.
